messages:
maria: FYI — after last night's KMS rotation I spotted a canary rollout that started even though the initiator didn't have rollout.canary permission. seems like a gate was skipped. :eyes:

samir: I see it too in traces. request to /api/v1/rollouts/canary returned 200, upstream authz returned success before the permission check. repro attached.

joel: that was me starting a little test canary at ~03:04 UTC. my token is SA-deploy-proxy, i didnt have explicit rollout.canary role. i assumed the proxy would map to my identity.

ana: we added delegated service-account mapping last quarter. the authz flow should map principal -> actor -> effective_roles. if introspection fails we should fail closed. could KMS rotation have broken token introspection?

deploy-bot: audit: canary_start - user: joel - actor: SA-deploy-proxy - token_id: tok_9x - result: success

maria: Audit entry is missing effective_roles array for that event. that indicates introspection returned partial data or was noop. if introspection fails we should not allow rollout start.

samir: quick glance at authz/checks.go — there is a fallback branch that calls allowOnIntrospectionFailure() for legacy reasons. thats probably the culprit.

kate: why was allowOnIntrospectionFailure added? i thought we tightened that code.

ana: it was added as a temporary toleration for transient KMS outages to avoid blocking noncritical reads. clearly canary_start is critical and should not be covered.

joel: can we abort that canary? how do we pause traffic or rollback?

samir: action plan: 1) pause canary traffic (eng-sre) 2) add temp RBAC deny for SA-deploy-proxy on rollout.canary 3) hotfix authz to treat introspect errors as deny for rollout endpoints 4) add missing audit fields and re-emit logs. will update in 10m.

maria: also open incident ticket and notify legal/compliance. this is an access-control regression during a KMS rotation window.

samir: assigning to myself. opening ticket now.

maria: patch snippet to use in hotfix:

```
if err := introspect(token); err != nil {
  return deny("token introspection failure")
}
```

no allowOnIntrospectionFailure for rollout APIs.

ana: add CI test that simulates token introspection failures and asserts deny for rollout endpoints. add a migration checklist item for KMS rotations.

deploy-bot: action: ticket created INC-1342 - "Canary creation bypass during KMS rotation" - severity: high - owner: samir

kate: fyi product: please review any canaries started in the rotation window for config exposure or data risks.

joel: my bad — i ran the test. i will help confirm there was no sensitive config leaked.

maria: follow-ups: 1) hotfix merged + deployed to authz canary 2) revoke tokens used (tok_9x) 3) re-ingest audit logs with effective_roles 4) postmortem documented to eng-security. samir + kate to own.

samir: update: paused traffic, hotfix merged to staging, deploying to prod now. revoked tok_9x. audit now includes effective_roles on new events. running CI tests.

ana: updating ops-runbook: add KMS rotation step to validate token introspection on each node and confirm authz test-suite green before cutover.

maria: thanks all. ping #all-hands when postmortem published.

deploy-bot: incident INC-1342 status: mitigated - timeline: 03:04 detection -> 03:18 mitigation -> 03:27 revoke + audit fix

samir: we'll follow up with a short postmortem and the exact commit ids for the hotfix. thanks for quick triage. :thumbsup:
